name: Player Ranks
description: Shows each connected player's external rating in Live Status. Sources: qlstats, Slipgate, Thunderdome elo-service, and the game server's own status data -- each can be shown or hidden independently, and every enabled source gets its own column. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer.

global.label: Slipgate API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. Optional -- without any key, Slipgate is still queried publicly, one request per player.

global.label: Thunderdome elo-service API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. This source returns nothing without a key, on any instance.

instance.label: internal: has this instance's Ranks tab ever been saved
Slipgate: API key / token override
instance.description: Optional -- with a key, one bulk request covers the whole roster; without one, one public request per player. Blank falls back to the installation-wide default set on the Addons page.

instance.label: Thunderdome elo-service: API key / token override
instance.description: Required -- nothing is returned without it. Blank falls back to the installation-wide default set on the Addons page.

instance.label: Thunderdome elo-service: game type / pool
instance.description: Leave blank to use the server's live game type. There is no fixed list of pools -- set this to the exact pool name the service was configured with.

instance.label: From the game server's own status data: show column

instance_ranks.description: Turn on any combination of rating sources for this instance -- each one that's on gets its own column in Live Status (up to 3 addon-contributed columns are shown at once; extras are dropped, oldest declared first). If server.cfg already carries qlx_balanceUrl or qlx_rankedServiceUrl, the first load here suggests matching values for the matching source -- nothing is written until you hit Save.

fields.label: Slipgate: API key / token override
fields.description: Optional -- with a key, one bulk request covers the whole roster; without one, one public request per player. Blank uses the installation-wide default from Settings.

fields.label: Thunderdome elo-service: API key / token override
fields.description: Required -- nothing is returned without it. Blank uses the installation-wide default from Settings.

fields.label: Thunderdome elo-service: game type / pool
fields.description: Blank = use the server's live game type. Set this to the exact pool name it was configured with.

fields.label: From the game server's own status data: show column

global_keys.description: Installation-wide default API keys. An instance's own 'Ranks' tab can override either one.
